structural_change: STW-S81c-HEAD-LANE 10-22 (successor of s81hd_lane_m/f: clock_rule FAIL boundary spread TT 81.5/FF 83.0 (m), TT 112.9 (f) on ONE ck root over an 812-um tile with pin flops on both opposite faces; and 812.16 x 583.2 did not fit the H10 reserve 518.4 x 1123.2): TWO REGIONAL CTS ROOTS -- ck = core/adapter region (N face pin flops, reset landing), ck_l = lane-body region (W face SerDes landing / gearbox beat flops). RTL: +1 port ck_l (u_ln and the rx-enable flop on ck_l); every ck <-> ck_l crossing is register -> register (fixed-latency landed seam, 0 added cycles; bench ck_l = ck cycle-identical). Portrait floorplan: lower block = the CLOSED dscoll_lane_w_s8ng map (gearbox + replay unchanged coordinates, SerDes pins W 2.16-576.72 as s8ng), RX FIFO block above (rows from 626.4), core landing u_ski column E straddling the seam, adapter band under the N face; ck_l entry on W beside the SerDes pins, ck entry N centre. Recipe 2 macro-edge guard (s8ng DRC lesson) + pin flops anchored at the faces. FALLBACK (enlarged +86.4: 5-column FIFO block, 196-um adapter band).
